actions.name: ai.settings.save
actions.title: Set up the AI service
actions.description: Fills in and saves the AI settings: the kind of service, its address, the model and whether people are offered the assistant. Never a key: when the service needs one, the operator pastes it into the Key field themselves, and an empty key keeps the one already saved.

kind.description: openai for any OpenAI-compatible address (Ollama too), anthropic for Anthropic's API.

endpoint.description: The service's address, starting with https:// or http://.

assistant.description: Whether to offer the assistant to people on this server.

actions.name: ai.connection.test
actions.title: Test the AI service
actions.description: Asks the saved AI service one short question and reports its answer. Changes no setting.
